### CVE-2021-21972
- Assigner: vmware | Published: 2021-02-24 | Updated: 2026-08-12 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: Remote code execution vulnerability; CWE-22 CWE-22 Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=active, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total
- **CISA KEV**: added 2021-11-03, ransomware=Known — VMware vCenter Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
- Exploit-DB 50056: VMware vCenter Server 7.0 - Remote Code Execution (RCE) (Unauthenticated) (webapps/multiple, 2021-06-24, verified=0)
- Exploit-DB 49602: VMware vCenter Server 7.0 - Unauthenticated File Upload (webapps/multiple, 2021-03-01, verified=0)

The vSphere Client (HTML5) contains a remote code execution vulnerability in a vCenter Server plugin. A malicious actor with network access to port 443 may exploit this issue to execute commands with unrestricted privileges on the underlying operating system that hosts vCenter Server. This affects VMware vCenter Server (7.x before 7.0 U1c, 6.7 before 6.7 U3l and 6.5 before 6.5 U3n) and VMware Cloud Foundation (4.x before 4.2 and 3.x before 3.10.1.2).

Affected:
- n/a / VMware vCenter Server: affected 7.x before 7.0 U1c; affected 6.7 before 6.7 U3l; affected 6.5 before 6.5 U3n
- n/a / VMware Cloud Foundation: affected 4.x before 4.2; affected 3.x before 3.10.1.2

### CVE-2021-21973
- Assigner: vmware | Published: 2021-02-24 | Updated: 2025-10-21 | Max CVSS: 5.3
- CWE: SSRF vulnerability; CWE-918 CWE-918 Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 5.3 MEDIUM `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=active, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial
- **CISA KEV**: added 2022-03-07, ransomware=Unknown — VMware vCenter Server and Cloud Foundation Server Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability

The vSphere Client (HTML5) contains an SSRF (Server Side Request Forgery) vulnerability due to improper validation of URLs in a vCenter Server plugin. A malicious actor with network access to port 443 may exploit this issue by sending a POST request to vCenter Server plugin leading to information disclosure. This affects: VMware vCenter Server (7.x before 7.0 U1c, 6.7 before 6.7 U3l and 6.5 before 6.5 U3n) and VMware Cloud Foundation (4.x before 4.2 and 3.x before 3.10.1.2).

Affected:
- n/a / VMware vCenter Server: affected 7.x before 7.0 U1c; affected 6.7 before 6.7 U3l; affected 6.5 before 6.5 U3n
- n/a / VMware Cloud Foundation: affected 4.x before 4.2; affected 3.x before 3.10.1.2

### CVE-2021-21974
- Assigner: vmware | Published: 2021-02-24 | Updated: 2026-06-02 | Max CVSS: 8.8
- CWE: OpenSLP heap-overflow vulnerability; CWE-787 CWE-787 Out-of-bounds Write
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 8.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

OpenSLP as used in ESXi (7.0 before ESXi70U1c-17325551, 6.7 before ESXi670-202102401-SG, 6.5 before ESXi650-202102101-SG) has a heap-overflow vulnerability. A malicious actor residing within the same network segment as ESXi who has access to port 427 may be able to trigger the heap-overflow issue in OpenSLP service resulting in remote code execution.

Affected:
- n/a / VMware ESXi: affected 7.0 before ESXi70U1c-17325551; affected 6.7 before ESXi670-202102401-SG; affected 6.5 before ESXi650-202102101-SG
- n/a / VMware Cloud Foundation: affected 4.x before 4.2 and 3.x

### CVE-2021-21985
- Assigner: vmware | Published: 2021-05-26 | Updated: 2026-08-12 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: Remote code execution vulnerability; CWE-20 CWE-20 Improper Input Validation; CWE-470 CWE-470 Use of Externally-Controlled Input to Select Classes or Code ('Unsafe Reflection'); CWE-918 CWE-918 Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=active, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total
- **CISA KEV**: added 2021-11-03, ransomware=Known — VMware vCenter Server Improper Input Validation Vulnerability

The vSphere Client (HTML5) contains a remote code execution vulnerability due to lack of input validation in the Virtual SAN Health Check plug-in which is enabled by default in vCenter Server. A malicious actor with network access to port 443 may exploit this issue to execute commands with unrestricted privileges on the underlying operating system that hosts vCenter Server.

Affected:
- n/a / VMware vCenter Server and VMware Cloud Foundation: affected VMware vCenter Server (7.x before 7.0 U2b, 6.7 before 6.7 U3n, 6.5 before 6.5 U3p) and VMware Cloud Foundation (4.x before 4.2.1, 3.x before 3.10.2.1)
